description: Source code for a web scraper class 'LekkerEnSimpel' that extracts recipe details from 'lekkerensimpel.com'. It includes methods for retrieving author, title, ingredients, instructions, and description, utilizing HTML parsing and schema validation.

classes.name: LekkerEnSimpel
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from lekkerensimpel.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host

methods.name: author
methods.description: Retrieves the author metadata from the HTML.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe title from the page.

methods.name: ingredients
